scene_summary: A wide abstract mixed-media painting on a warm parchment ground shows two heavily textured salmon-pink impasto masses with scorched crimson-black edges, joined by a turbulent lavender-magenta bruised core with dripping tendrils. A full-height scratched red-and-black vertical panel pierces the core just right of centre, while two thinner vertical bars on the right (one solid black, one with glitch-like horizontal striations) add a digital counterpoint.

detected_objects.label: tall red-and-black scratched vertical panel piercing the bruised core
detected_objects.visual_evidence: A full-height vertical band of saturated red over black with dense diagonal and cross-hatched scratch incisions and small drips. Its straight, slightly irregular left and right edges cut cleanly through the lavender-magenta impasto core near image centre, matching the planned anchor.
